steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: Three o'clock, 20 meters, caster target A.

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: Eight o'clock, 30 meters, commander behind the heavies.

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: Enemy sniper at ten o'clock. Heads down.
05:32 P.M. \ Clear
Lungmen Harbor - Rhodes Island Warship - Lower Deck Firing Range

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: This is only the fifth round.

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: And you're already slowing down on your targets, and not even hitting vitals.

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: In a real combat situation the enemy could've even shot back.

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: What's wrong, Jessica? Is this training exercise too hard for you?

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: Ah, er, phew... N- no!

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: Let's keep going!

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: You have the right attitude, but you need more strength behind it.

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: Let's take ten. Catch your breath.

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: I want to go over handgun basics with you one more time.

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: You can't neglect your fundamentals. Not even for a second.

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: Right!

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: First is balance and posture. No matter what kind of environment you're moving through, you can't let yourself go.

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: Keep your upper body low, protect your core.

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: Then, keep the Originium Arts you're using to control the gun nice and stable.

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: Feel the connection between your arm and the gun's interior. Reach out to the ammunition feeding into the chamber, then activate it and let it fly.

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: It's easier said than done. You have to meticulously engage your Originium Arts to trigger it.

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: If you lose control of your Arts, the gun could misfire. You could even damage it.

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: Last, line up your target, aim, fire, and move.

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: These are the absolute basic basics of Blacksteel firearms theory. You should be well acquainted with them, Jessica.

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: Now, do you know the biggest mistake you made with your shooting just now?

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: Um... I haven't trained enough, so I wasn't moving my center of gravity fast enough, and then I didn't control my Originium Arts very well...

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: And... I hesitated too much before firing, flinching and missing my targets.

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: Aaaahh! When I say it out loud, I messed up everything I did!

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: You're half right.

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: Jessica, you're trying to do everything all at once. You want to be fast, and you want to hit all your targets.

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: You find yourself worrying about every little thing. You end up getting spooked by your own tail.

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: And because you're so panicked, you're losing control of your Originium Arts. Then, when you start aiming at the enemy, you have to be running control tests inside your weapon.

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: That's why you have so much trouble shooting.

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: Th- that's what's happening...?!

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: The first thing you have to do is clear your mind of all those things you worry so much about, and just focus on your fingertips.

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: Trust your partner. The gun in your hand won't betray you.

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: The way you treat it, that's how it'll respond to you.

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: The speed and volume of your Arts aren't important. Just focus on maintaining precise control and stability.

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: Come on, let's go. I want to see you move past those three windows and hit as many targets as you can as fast as you can.

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: Go five rounds! Focus on your Originium Arts!

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: Got it!

steps.name: Franka
steps.text: Fundamentals, fundamentals, fundamentals. It's been three hours...

steps.name: Franka
steps.text: Get me out of this sweaty training room.

steps.name: Franka
steps.text: It's just a scouting mission in some ruins, an easy little thing for Jessica to take care of.

steps.name: Franka
steps.text: You think she'll run into a big baddie out for a stroll?

steps.name: Franka
steps.text: What I think she needs to train most of all is her confidence.

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: Looking at Blacksteel files, Jessica's stats are all completely middle-of-the-pack.

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: And it's not like she's not under pressure, with this special mission attached to Rhodes Island.

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: She's going out with Frostleaf and Meteorite and they'll take care of her. But making sure she's prepared can't hurt.

steps.name: Franka
steps.text: It's gonna hurt when she passes out from exhaustion in the ruins out there.

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: She came looking for me to train up her combat ability. She's worried she'll be a burden.

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: Right after the Lungmen cleanup, we're heading back to Blacksteel HQ. We don't have much time to train Jessica.

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: I'm trying to share as much of my experience as possible, especially with firearms.

steps.name: Franka
steps.text: You take such good care of your little girl. It's sweet.

steps.name: Franka
steps.text: Who knew you remembered we had to go back to Blacksteel.

steps.name: Franka
steps.text: We'll report on the Lungmen situation, but we also have the usual tests to go through.

steps.name: Franka
steps.text: You're not preparing at all? Not worried about your numbers?

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: I've already prepared everything we need to give to the company. It's not like I've been goofing off every night at Rhodes Island

steps.name: Franka
steps.text: Hehe, how did you know I've just been goofing off?

steps.name: Franka
steps.text: You really look after your teammates, Liskarm.

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: And as for my scores, if they drop too much and I get transferred, at least I won't have to deal with you—

steps.name: Franka
steps.text: Judging by what you've been doing with Jessica, I guess the idea is just to pile on the training so she gains experience?

steps.name: Franka
steps.text: I just see her grinding away over and over and over again.

steps.name: Franka
steps.text: I mean if you're just having a little firearms seminar, why not go get those sparkly angels?

steps.name: Franka
steps.text: They're the real gun masters, right? Bang! Pow! I bet they'd straighten Jessica out. A lot better than learning from you, anyway.

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: If you go ask them, all you'll get is, 'What is there to study? There is nothing simpler.' 'Why not just feel it out?' Answers like that.

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: To those angels, who walk around with multiple heavy weapons, a handgun like this is little more than a toy.

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: Laterano firearms practices are insanely advanced and complicated. She couldn't learn anything from them.

steps.name: Franka
steps.text: Heh. Makes you kind of envious, doesn't it?

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: Getting a handle on the fine control of Originium Arts under a wide variety of potential circumstances is no easy feat, and doesn't come with a typical training regimen.

steps.name: Franka
steps.text: Why do the Blacksteel bosses even want their people using such nasty weapons?

steps.name: Franka
steps.text: It's a long-range weapon that's harder to use than a crossbow, with more expensive ammunition, and more finicky maintenance.

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: The pistol is a logical enough choice for Blacksteel.

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: Standardized weapons make management easier for the company, reduce turnover, and screen out mediocrity.

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: Plus they have a guaranteed rate of fire and are easier to conceal than other ranged weapons.

steps.name: Franka
steps.text: All right, all right. I get it.

steps.name: Franka
steps.text: You just keep at it. I'm gonna head home, if you don't mind.

steps.name: Franka
steps.text: I'm cheering Jessica on in spirit. I need to rest up some more before we go back to HQ.

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: I didn't call you here for my health. Jessica needs your help too.

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: I can't teach her frontline assault and high speed maneuvers at the same time.

steps.name: Franka
steps.text: Just teach her to carry a big shield and move around while shocking people.

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: Be serious.

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: Your experience is worth a lot more to Jessica than my advice.

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: Moving back and forth around the front lines, breaking through the enemy's defenses, maintaining Originium Arts to power weapons.

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: Nobody in Blacksteel has the kind of control over Originium Arts that you do.

steps.name: Franka
steps.text: Stop stop stop already. How is it this kind of stuff just flows out of you?

steps.name: Franka
steps.text: You're embarrassing me.

steps.name: Franka
steps.text: Anyway, it's not that I'm against teaching Jessica. I just have no idea how to be a teacher.

steps.name: Franka
steps.text: What if she can't follow me? What if she can't keep up? I don't know if I can slow down.

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: That's fine. That's how Jessica would want it.

steps.name: Franka
steps.text: ...Have you actually looked at Jessica's numbers, the ones you just gave me?

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: No, is something wrong? How bad are they?

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: She's been working so hard...

steps.name: Franka
steps.text: Actually take a look, dumbass.

steps.name: Franka
steps.text: She doesn't top Blacksteel's charts, but in absolute terms she's not much worse than us.

steps.name: Franka
steps.text: We know Jessica could stand to be more confident, but these aren't a stupid kid's scores.

steps.name: Franka
steps.text: She's trained long and hard, and she's committed to not letting us down.

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: I... I had no idea.

steps.name: Franka
steps.text: Just make sure you don't teach Jessica to be a dumbass like you.
